description: Routing cases for the ten ESP personalization skills. Each case gives the model the ten name+description pairs and one user message, and asks which skill it would load. Descriptions are read live from skills/*/SKILL.md by scripts/run_routing_evals.py; nothing about them is duplicated here.

categories.named: The platform is named outright. The easy baseline.
categories.symptom: The platform is named but the question is a symptom with no language jargon.
categories.code-only: A pasted snippet, platform never named, syntax alone identifies it.
categories.confusable: Built to provoke cross-firing between lookalike platforms or same-vendor pairs.

fields.prompt: what the user types, verbatim, warts included
fields.expect: the slug that should fire, or null when nothing should
fields.accept: optional extra slugs that are defensible and are not counted as mis-fires
fields.expect_clarify: optional; true when asking which platform is a full pass
fields.category: one of the five categories above
fields.why: one line on what the case probes

cases.prompt: in braze whats the right way to stop the whole message sending if someone has no first name, dont want to email them a blank greeting
cases.why: Platform named and abort_message is called out in the Braze description.

cases.prompt: customer.io question - i put a snippet in the email and it renders as nothing, the snippet itself looks fine when i open it
cases.why: Platform named plus snippets, both in the Customer.io description.

cases.prompt: hubspot marketing email, i added a default filter to the first name token and it still comes out empty
cases.why: Platform named and the filters-in-email inversion is the HubL skill's headline case.

cases.prompt: need to build an abandoned cart email in iterable that loops the cart items and shows the image and price
cases.why: Platform named plus shoppingCartItems loops, named in the description.

cases.prompt: klaviyo flow email - how do i only show a block when the profile actually has a discount code on it
cases.why: Platform named plus conditional show/hide, named in the description.

cases.prompt: marketo email script token isnt outputting anything, the my. token just doesnt appear in the preview
cases.why: Platform named plus Email Script token, named in the description.

cases.prompt: in moengage how do i give a user attribute a fallback so the email still goes out
cases.why: Platform named plus fallback choice, the core of the MoEngage description.

cases.prompt: sailthru template, im looping our data feed and only want the first three items in the email
cases.why: Platform named plus data feed looping, named in the Zephyr description.

cases.prompt: salesforce marketing cloud email needs to pull the loyalty tier out of a data extension per subscriber
cases.why: Platform named plus Data Extension lookup, named in the description.

cases.prompt: zeta marketing platform campaign, trying to drop a recommendation block into the email body
cases.why: ZMP named outright plus the recommendation tag, which the ZML description lists.

cases.prompt: we sent a braze campaign this morning and some people got the email with a big empty gap where the product name should be, most were fine
cases.why: Braze named, symptom only, no Liquid jargon - tests the non-jargon half of the description.

cases.prompt: braze canvas step went out to way fewer people than entered it and support said check the activity log, im not sure what im looking for
cases.why: Message Activity Log and abort behaviour without naming Liquid or a tag.

cases.prompt: a chunk of our customer.io broadcast is sitting in failed and i cant tell what these people have in common
cases.why: The Failed delivery state is called out in the Customer.io description.

cases.prompt: we rebuilt an old customer.io campaign in design studio, same copy pasted across, and it renders differently to the original. nobody changed anything
cases.why: Per-message engine version is Customer.io specific and shows up only as a symptom here.

cases.prompt: hubspot wont let me publish the email, theres a red error bar at the top but the preview looked completely fine yesterday
cases.why: Template will not publish, named in the HubL description, with no language named.

cases.prompt: our hubspot email shows nothing at all where the company name goes for anyone who isnt attached to a company record
cases.why: Blank token symptom on an association, no HubL or Jinja mentioned.

cases.prompt: an iterable send went out with the actual curly brackets visible in the subject line, customers screenshotted it
cases.why: Raw braces in a sent message is verbatim in the Iterable description.

cases.prompt: klaviyo wont preview my template at all, it just errors, and this campaign is supposed to go out in an hour
cases.why: Preview failure, named in the Klaviyo description, phrased as panic not syntax.

cases.prompt: marketo email went out and the greeting printed the token text itself instead of the persons name, about 900 people saw it
cases.why: Token rendering literally is named in the Marketo description.

cases.prompt: my moengage campaign reached way fewer people than the segment said it would, like a third fewer, delivery report doesnt show them anywhere
cases.why: The canonical MoEngage null-removal symptom with no Jinja jargon at all.

cases.prompt: sailthru sent the campaign but the body was completely blank, went to about 12k people and i have to explain it
cases.why: Empty email sent is verbatim in the Zephyr description.

cases.prompt: few thousand subscribers in marketing cloud came back as errored on the last send and they never got anything, not even a bounce
cases.why: Errored/NotSent is the SFMC description's headline symptom.

cases.prompt: zeta marketing platform is telling me messages got skipped on yesterdays campaign and i cant find a reason anywhere in the ui
cases.why: Skipped messages on ZMP, named in the ZML description, with the platform disambiguated.

cases.prompt:
whats this doing exactly, inherited this template

{% if UserAttribute['first_name'] %}Hi {{UserAttribute['first_name']}}{% else %}{% MOE_NOT_SEND("no first name") %}{% endif %}
cases.why: MOE_NOT_SEND appears in no other platform and is named in the description.

cases.prompt:
is this line safe to keep

%%[ SET @x = Lookup("Content","Body","Key",@key) ]%%
%%=TreatAsContent(@x)=%%
cases.why: AMPscript delimiters and TreatAsContent identify SFMC with the platform never named.
Single-brace foreach over content is Zephyr and nothing else.

cases.prompt:
why does this render blank for half the list

{% if {{${first_name}}} != blank %}Hey {{${first_name}}}{% endif %}
cases.why: The ${} inside braces syntax exists only in Braze.

cases.prompt: does this url helper actually escape the email address unsubscribe
cases.why: A block helper in Handlebars form; urlEncode is Iterable's helper set.

cases.prompt:
getting Could not parse the remainder on this and i dont see whats wrong

{% if person|lookup:'VIP' == true %}...{% elsif person.orders > 3 %}...{% endif %}
cases.why: The Django parse error plus lookup filter syntax points at Klaviyo, not the Liquid skills.

cases.prompt:
this compiles but prints nothing for most people

#foreach( $opp in $OpportunityList )
  $opp.Name - $lead.FirstName
#end
cases.why: Velocity directives and $lead are Marketo Email Script and nothing else here.
crm_objects is HubSpot only and is named in the HubL description.

cases.prompt:
composer throws Unidentified method on save

{{ customer.first_name | default: 'there' | capitalise }}
cases.why: Unidentified method plus customer. namespace is the Customer.io description verbatim.
skip_message with percent tags is ZML; the trap is routing it to Sailthru because it says Zeta nowhere.

cases.prompt:
this line ships as literal text in the email, the rest of the template is fine

{ upper(profile.vars.first_name) }
cases.why: Single brace, function call not filter, and the fatal leading space - all Zephyr.
Connected Content is Braze only and named in the description.
Handlebars each over shoppingCartItems is Iterable's documented cart shape.

cases.prompt:
we're on zeta and this bit of the template isnt firing for anyone

{if profile.vars.plan == "pro"}show the upgrade block{/if}
cases.why: Says Zeta but the code is single-brace Zephyr; routing to zeta-zml would rewrite a working template.

cases.prompt: we use zeta for our email, how do i personalise the subject line with the first name and a fallback
cases.why: Zeta alone identifies neither platform; the honest answer is to ask which one before loading.

cases.prompt: zeta engage, i need to loop the content library into a three column block in the template
cases.why: Zeta Engage is the Sailthru product; content library is named in the Zephyr description.

cases.prompt: quick liquid question, whats the right way to write an if with two conditions in it, keep getting errors
cases.why: Liquid with no platform could be Braze, Customer.io, ZML or Shopify; guessing picks a syntax at random.

cases.prompt: whats the correct jinja fallback so a missing attribute doesnt wreck the email
cases.why: Jinja alone splits between HubSpot Jinjava and MoEngage, whose null behaviour is opposite.

cases.prompt: im writing jinja for our hubspot marketing emails, whats the syntax for a default on a contact property
cases.why: Jinja wording with HubSpot named; moengage-jinja is the trap.

cases.prompt: our moengage jinja template looks basically identical to the hubspot one we copied it from but people are going missing off the send
cases.why: Both platforms named; the platform that owns the problem is MoEngage.

cases.prompt: does {% assign %} behave the same in braze as it does in shopify liquid, we reuse snippets between the store and the esp
cases.why: Shopify is named but only as a comparison; the answerable half is Braze.

cases.prompt: in klaviyo whats the liquid filter for capitalising the first name, mine isnt working
cases.why: User calls it Liquid but Klaviyo is Django; the Liquid skills must not take this.

cases.prompt: were moving our welcome series off braze onto customer.io, do the liquid tags just carry across or do i need to rewrite them
cases.why: Genuinely spans two in-scope platforms; loading either or both is defensible.

cases.prompt: we run both marketo and salesforce marketing cloud. in the marketo one, how do i loop over custom objects in the email
cases.why: Both named, only one asked about; SFMC firing here is a real mis-route.

cases.prompt: does klaviyo use handlebars the same way iterable does, trying to reuse a cart block between them
cases.why: The premise is wrong; the Klaviyo skill has to fire to correct it. Iterable is defensible too.

cases.prompt: mailchimp *|FNAME|* is coming out blank for a load of subscribers, whats the fallback syntax
cases.why: Mailchimp is deliberately out of scope; merge tag phrasing must not pull in a personalization skill.

cases.prompt: shopify order confirmation notification, i need to show line item properties in the table
cases.why: Shopify Liquid is the closest lookalike to three in-scope skills and is explicitly excluded by all three.

cases.prompt: outlook is putting a gap under my images even though ive set display block and border 0, drives me mad
cases.why: A pure HTML/CSS rendering question with no templating language involved.

cases.prompt: open rates fell off a cliff after we moved to a new sending subdomain, dmarc is set up i think but im not certain
cases.why: Deliverability, not personalization; nothing in the set covers it.

cases.prompt: write me five subject lines for a black friday sale on running shoes, playful but not cringe
cases.why: Plain copywriting. Firing anything here is pure over-triggering.

cases.prompt: activecampaign conditional content block, how do i set a fallback on %FIRSTNAME%
cases.why: Another ESP with its own tag syntax, out of scope for all ten.

cases.prompt: sendgrid dynamic template, how do i loop over an array of items with handlebars
cases.why: Handlebars is named but the platform is SendGrid; iterable-handlebars says Iterable only.

cases.prompt: brevo template isnt filling in {{ contact.FIRSTNAME }}, just prints nothing for everyone
cases.why: Double-brace token on an out-of-scope ESP; the Liquid skills must not claim it.

cases.prompt: mailjet mjml template, is there a way to make a whole mj-section conditional
cases.why: MJML plus an out-of-scope ESP; the Figma/Email Love clause must not drag a skill in.

cases.prompt: how many emails should a welcome series be for a dtc skincare brand and how far apart
cases.why: Lifecycle strategy with no platform and no code. Nothing in the set is about cadence.
